# STYLE-7: A member's default goes at its declaration, and a zero default not at all

- ArduPilot zeroes class memory, so a zero initialiser only costs flash. A non-zero default goes at the declaration, not in the constructor body. A class declared on the stack is the exception.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Code Style](../claude/CLAUDE.md#code-style). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
